strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart in src/cart.js `cartTotal(items, { coupon })`: 10% bulk discount at 10+ total items, SAVE5 coupon ($5 off after the bulk discount, goods floored at $0, other codes throw), and $4.99 shipping below $50 of discounted goods (free at/above, empty cart $0). Unit tests in Vitest prove each rule and its boundaries. Reading the code, the bulk check uses `>` instead of `>=` (10 items get no discount) and the coupon lookup uses `in`, so prototype keys like `toString` are accepted; those cases are expected to fail and reported as defects.
inScope: cartTotal, bulkDiscount in src/cart.js: bulk discount, coupon, shipping rules and their boundaries
outOfScope: UI/checkout pages (none exist in the repo)
assumptions: Item count is the sum of line quantities; prices are dollars as numbers; amounts are rounded to cents by the module.
Coupon codes are case-sensitive: only exactly 'SAVE5' is valid.
Refusing a coupon means cartTotal throws; the test checks the thrown message contains the submitted code (the part the test controls).
Shipping applies to a non-empty cart even when the goods drop to $0 with SAVE5.
openQuestions: Should a coupon on an empty cart be accepted silently (current code returns $0)?

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart whose line quantities add up to 10 or more gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets no bulk discount.
Coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, goods never go below $0, and any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when discounted goods are $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart totals $0.

defects.title: Cart with exactly 10 items gets no bulk discount
defects.description: AC1: 10 or more items get 10% off. bulkDiscount in src/cart.js uses `itemCount > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so exactly 10 items get no discount.
defects.evidence: cartTotal([{price:10,quantity:4},{price:10,quantity:6}]) returns 100 instead of 90; the it.fails test passes.

defects.title: Coupon names matching Object.prototype keys are accepted
defects.description: AC2: any code other than SAVE5 must be refused. cartTotal validates with `coupon in COUPONS`, which is true for inherited keys such as 'toString', so no error is thrown.
defects.evidence: cartTotal(items, {coupon:'toString'}) does not throw; the it.fails test passes.
